summary: End-to-end verification of the freshly imported Customer Management app (Expo/RN + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed against the public URL covering user & admin login (JWT), role-guarded endpoints, initial empty state (customers/statistics/filter-options), master data CRUD for all 4 entities (segment, purchasing_size, top, area), full customer CRUD with GET-verification after each write, statistics/filter-options reflecting new data, CSV export, xlsx template, xlsx export, and xlsx import preview+commit round-trip. Frontend: user login -> user dashboard renders (KPI cards + donut charts), search screen opens; admin login -> admin dashboard renders with stats, admin customers list works, admin master-data screen shows all four tabs. Supabase / logo-upload flows were skipped per instructions (intentionally OFF). Test data was cleaned up so DB is left EMPTY as designed.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), Image style.resizeMode deprecated (use props.resizeMode). Non-blocking, but should be migrated. References: any component using shadowColor/Offset/Opacity/Radius in StyleSheet.create.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow, pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents, and Image style.resizeMode to props.resizeMode to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
No functional fixes required — freshly imported app boots and all requested flows verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2700 lines; consider splitting per-domain (auth, customers, master, import/export, supabase) for maintainability. Not a bug.

Master delete for 'top' uses hard collection name 'payment_terms_master' internally while the Supabase table is 'payment_terms' — mapping is intentional and correctly abstracted via MASTER_COLLECTION/MASTER_TABLE.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Tests created TEST_-prefixed master data and customers, verified them end-to-end, then cleaned everything up. DB is left empty per the fresh-install design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public base URL is https://mobile-crm-go.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Admin login screen uses testIDs admin-username-input/admin-password-input/admin-submit-button (not the login-* ones on /login). Admin dashboard route is /admin/dashboard; customers /admin/customers; master data /admin/master-data. Supabase and /api/admin/upload-logo are intentionally OFF — expect 400/unavailable there and do NOT report as bugs.
